audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown number anywhere (a flagged defect), Divine Judgment described only as 'her get-out at 6', and neither Starfire Spellblade's auto-reset nor Celestial Blessing's heal appears on the page.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 and only 80s at rank 3, so baiting it early buys nearly three minutes and baiting it late buys much less — the number is what makes the advice actionable. Starfire Spellblade is an 8s auto-reset at rank 1, so her burst arrives on an attack wind-up rather than a cast. Celestial Blessing heals on a flat 15s, which is what Grievous Wounds is actually for. Radiant Blast reduces resistances at 900 range.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t; the heal into the itemization line; the auto-reset tell into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] is headed 'Zone her off CS' but its body is the generic 'Kayle wastes Divine Judgment' line, and dontsFull[1] is headed 'Fight late vs her R' with a body about wasting your own cage.
audit.why: The headings are matchup-specific and the bodies are boilerplate from another matchup, so the two most-read cards say nothing about Kayle.
